Keeping "observability" in English, as the article does for trace, span and workflow, is a cheap fix. I rate it 2 because "ניטור" is common in Israeli dev speech.

Source: "| Ground truth | ...". Target: "| אמת מידה | ...". "אמת מידה" means a criterion or yardstick. In this table it sits next to "מעריך תוצאות", which is the thing that decides pass or fail, so the reader can take it as the scoring criterion. The phrase recurs in the heading "אל תבלבלו בינה לבין אמת מידה" and in "כשאמת המידה מוצמדת אליה". The live-scoring argument depends on "ground truth" being the expected answer, and that meaning gets blurred. In the heading, "בינה" also reads as "AI". "אמת קרקע" or "ground truth" used consistently would fix it.

Source: "short mechanical formatting". Target: "עיצוב מכני קצר", and "סיווג, עיצוב, שאלות ותשובות" in the `general` row. "עיצוב" does mean text formatting in some contexts. Next to "מכני", though, a developer audience may read it as design, and "פרמוט" or "עיצוב טקסט" is clearer. It is minor polish, not a meaning error, so I rate it 2 rather than 3.

Source: "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives". Target: "אחר הוא המקום שבו מצטלק הניסיון מהפרודקשן". The verb "מצטלק" means healing over or scarring, and it takes "הניסיון" as subject. The result is an image the reader has to decode. It loses the source's dry point that scars are what production failures leave behind. "יושבות הצלקות מפרודקשן" recreates the idiom naturally. This is the same defect as issue 9dbcb8048655088fd52a.

Source: "Hard-coded eval arrays". Target: "מערכי eval מקודדים קשיחים". "קידוד קשיח" is an attested Hebrew term for hard-coding, and the meaning is clear in context. "שמוגדרים ישירות בקוד" is a smoother alternative, but the current wording is a valid choice and not a blocking defect. The gender and number agreement is correct.

Source: "a paragraph of judgment calls". Target: "פסקה של החלטות שיפוטיות". "שיפוטיות" reads as judicial, meaning court-like, or as judgmental. The source means decisions that rest on discretion, in contrast to the "כללים דטרמיניסטיים" listed right after. "החלטות שמבוססות על שיקול דעת" keeps that contrast.

Target: "מהי דיוק הניתוב". "דיוק" is masculine, so the correct form is "מהו". This is an objective agreement error in a central explanatory sentence. The fix is trivial. Same defect as ea6fee8ecdc22261c7c0.

Source: "[Fight Evils with Evals!]", an imperative. Target: "נלחמים ברעות באמצעות הערכות!". "נלחמים" is present-tense plural, so it reads as a statement and not as the source's call to action. "באמצעות" is stiff for a playful title. The body keeps the word "evals" in English, while the title uses "הערכות". The near-rhyme is lost with nothing to compensate. "רעות" is a legitimate rendering of "Evils", so "צרות" would change the meaning and I don't endorse that part of the suggestion. An imperative such as "לחמו ברעות עם evals!" would be better, with the URL unchanged.

Same line and defect as issue 13ea8ecd86cfee537cfa. "מצטלק הניסיון מהפרודקשן" is an unnatural literal rendering, and it blunts the dry edge of the source's "production scar tissue lives". The suggested "יושבות הצלקות מפרודקשן" fixes it.

Source: "Averages are where useful failures go to retire". Target: "ממוצעים הם המקום שבו כשלים שימושיים הולכים לפרוש". It is word for word, and the policy says to recreate idioms. The humor survives partly, since "פורשים" is understood, but "ללכת לפרוש" is not a natural Hebrew pun. "בית האבות של כשלים שימושיים" is a stronger local recreation. This is minor polish and not blocking.
Target: "לא יכול לומר לכם מהי דיוק הניתוב". "דיוק" is masculine, so it should be "מהו". Same defect as issue 5b843ba490390faba9e9, and the fix is unambiguous.

Source: "scored `0.94` on route accuracy". Target: "קיבל ציון `0.94` בדיוק בניתוב". Right after a number, "בדיוק" naturally reads as "exactly", as in "exactly 0.94", and not as "in accuracy". The next bullet, "`0.98`", depends on this being a metric name. "קיבל `0.94` בדיוק הניתוב" removes the ambiguity. The cost is small.

Source: "It regressed two code-review cases". Target: "הוא נסוג בשני מקרי סקירת קוד". "נסוג" means retreated, which is not the usual term, and the same target uses "רגרסיה" for this concept elsewhere: "הרגרסיה המביכה" and "כל הרגרסיות". The wording is inconsistent, and a developer reader expects "רגרסיה" or "הידרדר". The meaning is still recoverable, so it is minor.

Target: "הצהרת `if` משעממת...שחוסכת לכם אלפי דולרים בחודש". Two defects. First, "הצהרה" means a declaration, whereas the source's `if` statement is "משפט" or "תנאי". Second, "דולרים" is a currency the source never names. The issue says "four figures fits אלפי roughly", and I disagree. "אלפי" means several thousands without an upper bound, while "four figures" is 1,000 to 9,999. The quantity change is a hard-constraint failure, as in issue 28a3e15e4c9a8c596542, so severity 2 understates it.

The intro link text is "אל תתחתן עם המודל שלך" (singular). The Resources entry for the same post is "אל תתחתנו עם המודל שלכם" (plural), and the article addresses readers in the plural elsewhere: "הפסיקו", "השתמשו". "טען את הטיעון הפשוט" is also a stiff cognate construction. Both are minor polish. The title inconsistency is real and easy to fix.

Same root defect as fcbb05f1e600c5805486. Source: "Ground truth". Target: "אמת מידה", also in "כשאמת המידה מוצמדת אליה" and in the heading. It means criterion, not the expected answer. The issue rates it 2, but it is repeated in a heading and in the live-scoring argument, where the distinction carries the point, so I rate it 3.

Same as issue 0b6392982a07a8837158. Source: "observability constraints". Target: "וניטור". The text later separates monitoring from controlled tests, so "ניטור" collides with that use. Retaining "observability" is a cheap fix, and this is minor polish.

Source: "the failed customer ticket". Target: "פנייה שנכשלה מצד לקוח". "מצד לקוח" (on the part of a customer) modifies "נכשלה", so the phrase can read as a failure on the customer's side. "פניית לקוח שנכשלה" is clearer and more idiomatic. Minor polish only.

Source: "saves you four figures a month". Target: "שחוסכת לכם אלפי דולרים בחודש". It adds an unnamed currency and replaces a bounded four-digit quantity with an open-ended one. This is a hard-constraint failure that blocks. The proposed "סכום בן ארבע ספרות בחודש" preserves both the magnitude and the source's unspecified currency.

The target uses "| אמת מידה | ..." for the source's "Ground truth". In Hebrew, אמת מידה means a criterion or benchmark, not the expected label. The table already has a separate criterion-like row, "מעריך תוצאות", so using אמת מידה for ground truth muddies the distinction between the expected answer and the scorer. The code field is `groundTruth`. The same term appears later, in the heading and in "כשאמת המידה מוצמדת אליה", so fix it everywhere. Either "תשובת הייחוס (ground truth)" or plain "ground truth" works.

The target renders "short mechanical formatting" as "עיצוב מכני קצר". עיצוב does cover text formatting in Hebrew UI usage, but "עיצוב מכני" leans toward design, not a reformatting task. The general row's "סיווג, עיצוב" is readable in context. This is polish, not a noticeable meaning error. "שינוי פורמט" would read more naturally.

The source says "safety, privacy, and observability constraints". The target narrows observability to "ניטור" (monitoring). This article deals with trace spans and evidence preservation, and it is tagged `observability`. It also contrasts "Live scoring is monitoring" with other evaluation, so collapsing observability into monitoring blurs a distinction the text relies on. Hebrew developers commonly use observability as a loanword. Keep the English term here.

The target renders "judgment calls" as "פסקה של החלטות שיפוטיות". שיפוטי primarily means judicial, so the phrase evokes court rulings rather than discretionary engineering choices. That is a noticeable register and meaning slip. "החלטות שמבוססות על שיקול דעת" or "החלטות על דעת עצמו" would fix it.

"מצטלק הניסיון מהפרודקשן" says that experience itself scars. That is an unnatural collocation, and the image of production scar tissue living in the "Other" row is lost. The suggested "בקטגוריית 'אחר' יושבות כל הצלקות מהפרודקשן" recreates the dry image in natural Hebrew. Severity 3 because this is a signature voice line.

"מערכי eval מקודדים קשיחים" is a calque. Israeli developers usually say "hard-coded" or "מוגדרים ישירות בקוד", and the "קשיחים" agreement makes it sound translated. The meaning survives, so this is minor polish, not a noticeable error.

The target's "נלחמים ברעות באמצעות הערכות!" drops the evils/evals soundplay. Unvocalized, "רעות" can also be read as רְעוּת (friendship), which makes the title ambiguous as well as flat. The source title is a punchy joke. Recreate it, for example "נלחמים בתקלות עם evals!", keeping the URL unchanged.
"מהי דיוק הניתוב" contains a gender-agreement error, because דיוק is masculine. It should be מהו, or simply "מה דיוק הניתוב". The error is small but visible.

This is the same defect as 5c12af53. The heading "אל תבלבלו בינה לבין אמת מידה" and the sentence "כשאמת המידה מוצמדת אליה" use a criterion word for the source's "ground truth stapled to it". That breaks the point that production traffic lacks reference labels, and it mismatches `groundTruth` in the code. Fix all occurrences consistently.

The source says "saves you four figures a month". The target has "אלפי דולרים בחודש", which adds a currency the source does not state. "אלפי" roughly covers the thousands magnitude, so the numeric range is approximately kept, but the added currency is an unsupported specifier and should be removed. "אלפים בחודש" or "סכום של ארבע ספרות בחודש" would fix it. "תנאי `if`" is also better than "הצהרת `if`".
This duplicates d01814ab. "מהי דיוק" is a masculine/feminine agreement error in the target. Use מהו, or drop the pronoun.

"פנייה שנכשלה מצד לקוח" awkwardly attaches the failure to the ticket itself, and "מצד לקוח" dangles. The source's "the failed customer ticket" means a customer case the system handled badly. This is minor polish: "פנייה של לקוח שהמערכת פישלה בה" is more natural and fits the voice.

The target is internally inconsistent. The opening link reads "אל תתחתן עם המודל שלך" (singular), while the resources list reads "אל תתחתנו עם המודל שלכם" (plural), and the rest of the article addresses the reader in the plural. The same linked post appears under two titles. Use the plural form in both places.

This duplicates 16deb538. I agree the "מצטלק הניסיון" line needs repair, but I rate it 3, not 2. It is a deliberate voice line, and the current wording reads as a garbled idiom, not dry humor. The suggested "יושבות צלקות הפרודקשן" is a good fix.
In "מסירות העבודה למודלים פרימיום", "מסירות עבודה" is a stiff rendering of "handoffs". "העברות למודלים פרימיום" is more natural. The 18% is preserved, so this is polish only.

On its own, "שכבת הניתוב מספיק רופפת" can read as flimsy. Hebrew does have the established term "צימוד רופף" (loose coupling), so "בצימוד רופף" would carry the intended meaning precisely. I prefer that over the proposed "מנותקת", which overstates it. This is minor polish.

For "Route to the best model with confidence.", "נתבו למודל המתאים ביותר בביטחון" is a valid alternative. In a routing context, "best" means best for the task, so "המתאים ביותר" is arguably clearer. "בביטחון" is acceptable Hebrew and echoes "Don't Fear". There is no defect.

The target mixes the maqaf (for example "ב־`runEvals`", "ב־workflow") with ASCII hyphens (for example "ה-JSON", "ל-Mastra") before Latin and code tokens. It does not affect meaning or code, but it is visible to a developer audience. Standardizing on one form is cheap polish.

The currency addition in "אלפי דולרים בחודש" is real, and it should be fixed. I dispute severity 4, though. "Four figures" is an idiomatic order of magnitude, not a measured quantity, and "אלפי" stays in the same thousands range. The only unsupported addition is "דולרים", which is a noticeable issue but not meaning-critical. The one-word fix ("אלפים בחודש") should be made, but it should not block as a hard failure.

This duplicates 651c5d25, and I reach the same assessment. "אלפי דולרים" adds a currency not present in "four figures a month", so it needs repair. "אלפי" still maps to the thousands magnitude, so the quantity is loosened only slightly. Severity 3, not blocking. Fix: "שחוסך לכם אלפים בחודש".

I uphold the defect, but at severity 3, not 4. It is a real voice and idiom problem. It is not a meaning, technical or blocking readability error.

The quoted line, "אחר" הוא המקום שבו מצטלק הניסיון מהפרודקשן, renders the source's "Other" is where the production scar tissue lives. It changes "scar tissue" into "experience scars over", an awkward verb that sounds translated, and it loses the dry edge. A natural fix: "'אחר' זה איפה שיושבות הצלקות מהפרודקשן."

The same literal pattern appears elsewhere:
- "ממוצעים הם המקום שבו כשלים שימושיים הולכים לפרוש" translates "go to retire" word for word. "ממוצעים הם בית האבות של כשלים שימושיים" would recreate the joke.
- The resource title "נלחמים ברעות באמצעות הערכות!" drops the Evils/Evals pun and reads like a stiff literal title.
- The linked post's title is inconsistent: singular "אל תתחתן עם המודל שלך" in the opening, plural "אל תתחתנו עם המודל שלכם" in Resources.

The issue's praise is fair. "תחושת בטן עם טבלת ניתוב" and "גלאי עשן עם סוללה" read naturally.

None of these problems changes a fact, code or URL, so a block is not justified. They still keep idiom recreation below a credible local voice and should be polished.

Target row "אמת מידה" renders source "Ground truth" (expected label). In Hebrew it reads as criterion or standard, which collides with the adjacent scorer row. The code uses `groundTruth`, so a dev reader loses the mapping. Fix: one consistent term ("אמת קרקע" or "תשובת הייחוס (ground truth)"). It also has to match the later heading and the production-traffic paragraph.

"עיצוב מכני קצר" is a normal Hebrew rendering of "short mechanical formatting". "עיצוב טקסט" is the standard term for formatting, and the word "מכני" plus the neighbouring "סיווג" and "חילוץ" rows fix the sense. "שינוי פורמט" would be an acceptable alternative, but this is a preference, not a blocking defect.

Source "observability constraints" became "וניטור" (monitoring). The article itself later says "Live scoring is monitoring", and the tags include observability. Narrowing the term blurs a distinction the article relies on. Keeping "observability" or "תצפיתיות" fixes it.

Target "פסקה של החלטות שיפוטיות" for "judgment calls". "שיפוטיות" reads as judicial, or as judgmental in the pejorative sense. The intended meaning is decisions made on discretion. "שיקול דעת" is the natural fix.

Target "מצטלק הניסיון מהפרודקשן" is an awkward coinage: experience does not scar. It loses the source "scar tissue lives" image and the dry-humor landing of the line. Replace it with the plain image, e.g. "יושבות צלקות הפרודקשן".

Target "מערכי eval מקודדים קשיחים" is a literal calque of "hard-coded". Israeli developers say "הארדקודד" or "מוגדרים ישירות בקוד". In a text that otherwise sounds natural, this stiff phrase stands out.

Target link text "נלחמים ברעות באמצעות הערכות!" drops the "Evils/Evals" wordplay without any note, and "רעות" is stilted. Idioms and metaphors are supposed to be recreated. The suggested "תקלות" shifts the meaning (evils become bugs), so a better fix keeps the evil/evals contrast or the combative tone without changing the claim.
Target "מהי דיוק הניתוב" has a real gender-agreement error, because "דיוק" is masculine. It should be "מהו" or "מה". It is minor but objective.

Target heading "אל תבלבלו בינה לבין אמת מידה" and "כשאמת המידה מוצמדת אליה" use "אמת מידה" (criterion) for "ground truth". The "stapled ground truth" point loses its meaning, and the term does not match `groundTruth` in the code. Same root cause as the table-row issue, so the fix must be applied consistently.

Source "saves you four figures a month" has no currency. Target "אלפי דולרים בחודש" adds dollars and turns a bounded 1,000–9,999 into open-ended "thousands". That breaks the hard constraint on factual quantities and the no-new-claims rule. The earlier history draft's "ארבע ספרות בחודש" was correct. I am raising this to 4 because it is a deterministic quantity change, not just stylistic. The "הצהרת if" nit is secondary.
Same gender error as the other issue on this sentence: "מהי דיוק" should be "מהו" or "מה". The fix is trivial and the defect is objective.

Target "פנייה שנכשלה מצד לקוח" reads as if the ticket failed, and "מצד לקוח" is clumsy. The source means the customer ticket the system handled badly. Use something like "פנייה של לקוח שהמערכת פישלה בה".

Intro link text "אל תתחתן עם המודל שלך" is singular. The rest of the article addresses the reader in the plural, and the Resources list uses "אל תתחתנו עם המודל שלכם". The same post title appears in two different forms, so it should be unified.
Same phrase as the higher-severity scar issue. "מצטלק" is an unnatural verb and "lives" is lost. A minor polish fix such as "יושבות צלקות הפרודקשן" resolves both issues together.
Target "מסירות העבודה למודלים פרימיום" is a stiff calque for "handoffs". "ההעברות למודלים פרימיום" is simpler and more natural, and it loses nothing.

"רופפת" matches the established Hebrew term "צימוד רופף" (loose coupling). The following clause, "כך שהחלפת ספק לא תהפוך...", makes the decoupling meaning clear. It mirrors source "loose" and is at most a stylistic alternative, not a defect.
The issue itself calls this optional. "המתאים ביותר" is a valid rendering of "best" in a subtitle, and "בביטחון" is acceptable for "with confidence". It is a preference and does not block.

The target mixes the maqaf ("ב־`runEvals`", "ה־workflow" in later sections) with the ASCII hyphen ("ה-JSON", "ל-Mastra" in early sections). The inconsistency is real but cosmetic, so it is minor polish only.

Target "שחוסכת לכם אלפי דולרים בחודש" against source "saves you four figures a month". The currency (dollars) is unsupported, and "אלפי" loosens the explicit four-digit bound. This violates the preserve-factual-quantities hard constraint and blocks until repaired, e.g. "ארבע ספרות בחודש".

Same defect as the other savings-quantity issue: "אלפי דולרים" adds a currency that is not in the source and drops the bounded four-digit quantity. It is a hard-constraint quantity failure, so it blocks until fixed.

The issue doesn't support severity 4 (blocking). The quoted line "אחר" הוא המקום שבו מצטלק הניסיון מהפרודקשן is a recreated idiom for the source's "production scar tissue". It keeps the meaning and the attitude. "מצטלק" is a bit literary, and "צלקות מהפרודקשן" would read a little more naturally. That is minor polish. It isn't a meaning, technical or readability error. The claim also says most metaphors "remain literal enough to sound translated", and the target doesn't bear that out. "נתב המודלים שלכם הוא תחושת בטן עם טבלת ניתוב" recreates "vibes with a dispatch table". "גלאי עשן עם סוללה" recreates the smoke alarm line. "מקדש", "מסלול הביצוע הוא המקום שבו הבאגים חיים" and "ממוצעים הם המקום שבו כשלים שימושיים הולכים לפרוש" keep the dry edge and read fine in Hebrew. The resource link "נלחמים ברעות באמצעות הערכות!" is clumsy. It flattens the Evils/Evals wordplay. It also mismatches the intro's "אל תתחתן עם המודל שלך", which uses the singular, while the resource list uses "אל תתחתנו עם המודל שלכם". Those are optional or consistency polish at most, and another post's title isn't a hard constraint. Nothing here blocks publication. I'd accept it as a visible severity 2 polish item.
במקור “Ground truth” הוא הנתיב או ההתנהגות הצפויים; “אמת מידה” בתרגום עלולה להתפרש כקריטריון ההערכה עצמו. ההגדרה בטבלה מצמצמת את הבלבול, אך “תשובת הייחוס (ground truth)” תבהיר את ההבחנה גם בהמשך.

“short mechanical formatting” נעשה “עיצוב מכני קצר”, שעלול להישמע כעבודת עיצוב ולא כפעולת פורמט פשוטה. אלה דוגמאות שמגדירות את גבולות הניתוב; “משימות קצרות של שינוי פורמט” ו“שינוי פורמט” בשורת general יהיו ברורים יותר.
המקור מבחין בין “observability constraints” לבין “Live scoring is monitoring”, ואילו התרגום משתמש ב“ניטור” בשניהם. כך נעלמת הבחנה טכנית רלוונטית למאמר; כדאי להשאיר observability במופע הראשון.
